text:
emily: Kicking off relnotes draft for the docs deploy. Focus: changelog bullets, one Known Issue, SDK snippet parity, and a small migration blurb for Dedicated routing. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

rob: I'll run a linkcheck and patch any renamed anchors. Please flag pages that need snippet updates so I can scope the PR.

tanvi: Noted divergence: a handful of pages still use old client patterns (`Client.create` / `new Client()`); we should standardize to `const client = new RedwoodClient(...)` + `await client.responses.create(...)`. I'll prepare a sed patch.

marc: Known Issue proposal: "Embeddings streaming may intermittently return 403s on long multi-chunk uploads. Workaround: set batch_size=1 and enable prefix_cache." I'll attach internal eval EVAL-2024-10-18 with repro steps.

emily: Good. Also add a two-line migration blurb for Dedicated: "Routing policy v2 changes fallback ordering to prefer lower-latency regional variants. Customers pinning model IDs should verify rollouts after upgrade and contact SE for assisted migration."

rob: I'll batch link redirects + snippet fixes into the relnotes PR to minimize churn for translators. List of files to touch will be in the PR description.

intl-bot: intl-checker: 2 files with placeholder order differences: /docs/quickstart and /docs/guides/embed-stream. Tickets created: INTL-1102, INTL-1103

tanvi: I'll update examples and include try/catch where appropriate. Also will standardize double quotes per style guide. After my commit, please hold merges until intl confirms.

docs-bot: docs-ci started for PR #5120 -- status: running

rob: Redirect PR opened for renamed anchors and file list added to relnotes PR description. CI pending.

emily: Timeline: localization cutoff 2024-09-30 EOD UTC. Publish target 2024-10-10 16:00 PT. After cutoff, only critical string fixes.

marc: Pasted the embeddings repro and quick troubleshooting snippet into the relnotes PR comment and linked EVAL-2024-10-18.

rob: CI passed for redirects; merged. Pushed snippet parity commits to the relnotes PR.

intl-bot: intl status: placeholders normalized in most files, awaiting translator confirmation for fr/zh.

emily: Thanks all. Once intl thumbs-up is in, I'll do a final proof and cut the release branch. :rocket:
